name: realie
description: U.S. property data from Realie: parcel lookup by address or APN, property search, nearby parcels, and comparable sales, via Realie's hosted MCP server.

interface.longDescription:
Look up U.S. property data in ChatGPT: parcel records, property owners, sales history, mortgages, liens, foreclosures, tax assessments, building details, and automated value estimates (AVM) for 164M+ parcels across all 50 states and DC.

Realie normalizes county assessor and recorder data into one record per parcel. You can:
- Look up a property by street address, or by parcel ID / APN plus state and county
- Search properties in a state by county, city, ZIP code, address, use code, foreclosure status, or recent sale date
- Find properties near a latitude/longitude within a radius
- Pull comparable sales near a subject property, filtered by size, beds, baths, price, property type, and time frame
- Search properties by owner name

Common uses: real estate investing and deal analysis, property valuation and comps, property and collateral research, portfolio research, and market research.

All tools are read-only. List tools return up to 10 properties per call and continue with a cursor or offset.

Requires a Realie account with API access; you sign in with Realie when you connect. Each successful tool call counts toward your existing Realie plan.

Realie is not a consumer reporting agency. Realie data may not be used to decide an individual's eligibility for credit, insurance, employment, or housing.
capabilities: Look up a property by street address
Look up a parcel by APN or Realie parcel ID
Search properties by county, city, ZIP, use code, or foreclosure status
Find comparable sales for a property
defaultPrompt: Look up 10663 Fairhaven Way, Orlando, FL. What's it worth and when did it last sell?
Find 3+ bed house sales from the last year within 1 mile of 10663 Fairhaven Way, Orlando, FL.
Find homes in Winter Park, FL that sold since January 1, 2026.

positive.description: Look up a single-family home by street address and report assessor, valuation, and sale fields
positive.prompt: Look up 10663 Fairhaven Way, Orlando, FL (Orange County). What are the beds, baths, square footage, year built, assessed value, property tax, estimated value, and last sale?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 10663 Fairhaven Way, Orlando, FL 32825 (realieParcelId 12095-08-23-31-0174-00-030): 4 beds, 2.5 baths, 2,538 sq ft, built 1998, pool, assessed value $446,520, 2025 property tax $7,757.34, Realie estimated value about $556,700, last sale July 12, 2021 for $360,000.

positive.description: Look up a parcel by APN with state and county
positive.prompt: Get the parcel record for APN 32-22-31-9350-02-360 in Orange County, FL: address, owner, beds, baths, square footage, assessed value, lot size, and legal description.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 1003 Old Barn Rd, Orlando, FL (realieParcelId 12095-32-22-31-9350-02-360): owner FKH SFR Propco A LP, 4 beds, 2 baths, 1,815 sq ft, built 1997, assessed value $373,350, about 0.13 acres, legal description WINDING CREEK UNIT 3 31/82 LOT 236.

positive.description: Find comparable sales for a subject property given by address
positive.prompt: Find comparable 3+ bedroom house sales from the last 12 months within 1 mile of 10663 Fairhaven Way, Orlando, FL, with sale price, beds, baths, and square footage.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the subject's coordinates, then lists up to 10 nearby 3+ bedroom house sales from the last 12 months with address, sale date, sale price, beds, baths, and square footage (for example 3024 Natoma Way, 4 beds, 2,224 sq ft, sold May 2026 for $495,000).

positive.description: Search a city for recent sales
positive.prompt: Find homes in Winter Park, FL (Orange County) that sold since January 1, 2026. Show the first few with sale date, sale price, bedrooms, and square footage.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 10 Winter Park residential properties with transfers since January 1, 2026, each with sale date, sale price when recorded, bedrooms, and square footage (for example 449 Seymour Ave, 3 beds, 1,903 sq ft, sold May 15, 2026 for $1,195,000), and offers to fetch more.

positive.prompt: Find properties within a quarter mile of Lake Eola Park in downtown Orlando (latitude 28.5431, longitude -81.3727) and list their addresses and building sizes.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 10 parcels within 0.25 miles of the point, each with address and building size (for example 415 E Pine St and 431 E Central Blvd).

negative.description: Tenant or credit screening of an individual is prohibited (Realie is not a consumer reporting agency)
negative.prompt: Use Realie to decide whether I should approve Jane Doe's rental application based on the properties she owns.

negative.description: The plugin is read-only and cannot change property or ownership records
negative.prompt: Update the owner of record for 10663 Fairhaven Way, Orlando, FL to my name.
Look up the property records for 10 Downing Street, London.

review.commerce_description: Realie does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Tool calls use the connected Realie account's existing plan.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: address, parcel/APN, property search, nearby search, comparable sales, and owner-name tools over Realie's hosted MCP server, plus a property-research skill.
